judged_text: String#scrub requires Ruby >= 2.1; on Ruby 2.0, which Discourse targeted at this time, it raises NoMethodError even for valid strings

record.issue_text: String#scrub requires Ruby >= 2.1; on Ruby 2.0, which Discourse targeted at this time, it raises NoMethodError even for valid strings

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces an unconditional call to `String#scrub` in `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb` (`content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`). If `scrub` is not defined on `String` in the runtime, this will raise `NoMethodError` and break feed polling/importing. The diff provides no fallback/guard around `scrub`.
